name: Construction
blurb: Computer-vision safety monitoring, BIM clash detection, and autonomous site scanning, sourced from AGC, BuiltWorlds, and the proptech and contech trackers.

points.desc: The Census BTOS series reports construction AI use directly from firms, fortnightly.
points.name: Adoption is measured, not guessed

points.desc: The construction-technology research network tracks site robotics, jobsite IoT, and digital preconstruction across research programs and member benchmarking.
points.name: BuiltWorlds runs the sector intelligence

points.desc: The Associated General Contractors of America surveys technology adoption and safety-technology compliance across US builders - the trade body's data is the adoption record.
points.name: AGC tracks contractor adoption

points.desc: CREtech and MetaProp track venture flow across architecture, engineering, and construction technology alongside property tech.
points.name: Proptech capital reaches AEC too

summary: Computer-vision safety monitoring, BIM clash detection, and autonomous site scanning are the working deployments - the sector's AI mostly watches the jobsite and checks the model against reality before concrete is poured.
